title: Figure 7. Qubit piano illustration; Figure 8. Long distance coupling of graphene qubits
description: Figure 7 is a color 3D illustration of a graphene nanoribbon with red quantum-dot bars and blue barrier bars, with colored spheres and links marking strongly coupled spin qubits; captioned "Figure 7. Qubit piano. Illustration of many spin qubits in a line hosted within a graphene nanoribbon." Figure 8 is a band diagram of alternating regions labeled Barrier1–Barrier4 and Dot1–Dot3, showing blue conduction and red valence cones with energy levels Δε1 and Δε2. It is captioned "Figure 8. Long distance coupling of three graphene qubits."
